maya: heads up — I’m seeing a regression after quantizing the reranker to q4_0 on the ms_marco holdout. mrr@10 dropped ~0.04 absolute vs fp16. ndcg also down. not sure if it’s model ordering or eval formatting. running a few ablations now.

samir: which split + candidate pool size? did you change doc truncation or query normalization between runs? can you paste the eval cmd you used?

maya: using ms_marco_tiny holdout, topk=100. command I ran:
```
python eval_rerank.py --model checkpoints/rerank-q4_0 --dataset ms_marco_tiny --topk 100 --doc_trunc 512 --qfmt orig --seed 42
```
quick output (fp16 -> q4_0): ndcg@10 0.589 -> 0.551, mrr@10 0.274 -> 0.232. logs in /tmp/rerank_q4_diff.log

eval-bot: automated results posted:
- ndcg@10: 0.589 -> 0.551 (-6.5%)
- mrr@10: 0.274 -> 0.232 (-15.3%)
run-id: eval_2026_03_05_17_20 seed=42

olivia: hmm. two quick possibilities: tokenization / query formatting differences (whitespace/punct), or quantization changed ranking near ties. can you compute kendall-tau / topk overlap between fp16 and q4_0? also verify candidate generator scores haven't shifted (that would change the input set).

maya: re-ran with doc_trunc=1024 and simple query normalization (lower + strip punctuation). partial recovery: ndcg@10 0.571, mrr@10 0.258. so formatting helps but doesn't fully close gap. snippet of per-query delta (score_q4 - score_fp16) for top5: 
```
{"q12345": -0.47, "q23456": -0.05, "q34567": -0.12, "q45678": +0.03, "q56789": -0.62}
```

ryan: is the eval harness deterministic? are we comparing identical candidate doc lists? quant kernels can change tie-breaking if fused softmax or ordering differs. try running with fused_kernels=false and see. :thinking:

samir: plan suggestion — run a small ablation matrix: fp16, q4_0, q3_k (if available). for each: (1) with/without query normalization, (2) doc_trunc 512/1024, (3) fused_kernels on/off. also compute per-query delta distribution and flag queries with >0.5 AP drop. i can set up the sweep.

maya: thanks — starting the sweep now. will upload per-query deltas + example doc texts to s3://redwood-evals/rerank/q4_regression/1768401234/ . will also attach a short list of top 50 queries that flipped ranking. :thumbsup:

olivia: also recommend adding BEIR subset + our internal search-prod sample — ms_marco alone might be sensitive to passage/document formatting. report ndcg@1 and recall@100 in addition to ndcg@10/mrr.

eval-bot: job scheduled: job_id=jr_9072; ETA ~45m. will post final metrics and per-query diffs when done.
